fallback.behavior: select all catalogued bundles and preserve all existing path-triggered workflows

limits: The selector is advisory and does not skip, cancel, or replace existing workflows.
The first map covers three high-impact families; unclassified paths select all mapped bundles while existing path-triggered gates remain authoritative.
This is not yet a complete TST-002 assertion inventory, proof that every critical contract is covered, a CI cost reduction, or authorization to consolidate other workflows.
Future additions to bundles require current trigger/command review and historical path cases before any gate can be removed.
